_about: 美联储是否在 2025-12-31（含）前的 FOMC 会议上再次下调目标区间的冻结证据包。信息截至 2025-10-31T23:59Z（10 月会议之后、12 月会议之前）。

evidence.title: Implementation Note issued October 29, 2025
evidence.excerpt: the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to 3-3/4 to 4 percent.
evidence.claim: 10 月会议已降息至 3.75%–4.00%；12 月是否再降取决于后续数据，尚未决定。

evidence.title: FOMC statement (October 29, 2025) — New York Fed copy
evidence.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
evidence.excerpt: In support of its goals and in light of the shift in the balance of risks, the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate
evidence.claim: 官方声明未对 12 月行动作任何承诺，措辞强调"风险平衡变化"。

evidence.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement (September 17, 2025)
evidence.excerpt: the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to 4 to 4-1/4 percent.
evidence.claim: 9 月已降息至 4.00%–4.25%，是 10 月会议前的政策起点。

evidence.title: FOMC Press Conference, October 29, 2025
evidence.claim: 会后记者会记录显示委员会对未来路径存在分歧，12 月行动未定。
